The lab

Where the molecules actually come from.

Peptide Tech LLC is a US research-supply company built on one idea: a peptide is only as good as the data that proves it. So we publish the data — for every batch.

≥99%
HPLC purity
160+
research SKUs
ISO 17025
accredited lab
5×
tests per batch
Our standard

We don't ship until the data says pass.

Most of this market is opaque. Vials arrive with no documentation, no lot tracking, and no way to confirm what's inside. We were built as the opposite of that.

Every batch is synthesized, lyophilized, and finished in the United States, then tested at an independent accredited lab before a single vial leaves the building. The results aren't a marketing line — they're a document you can read, download, and verify against your own bench.

Standards

Five tests, one accredited lab, one release decision

Third-party tested

Every batch ships only after passing at an independent ISO 17025 accredited laboratory.

≥99% HPLC purity

Reverse-phase HPLC at a fixed detection wavelength, with the main-peak percentage published on every COA.

Lot-traceable

A QR code on every vial maps back to a single manufactured lot and its full analytical record.

Cold chain

Lyophilized vials ship insulated with gel packs, dispatched fast on in-stock orders.

Shipping Policy

Last updated: May 1, 2026

1. Order Processing

Orders are processed Monday through Friday, excluding U.S. federal holidays. Most orders are processed within 1–2 business days of payment confirmation. Orders placed before 1:00 PM Eastern Time on a business day typically ship quickly, subject to inventory availability and order volume.

Stated shipment timeframe. Company’s stated shipment timeframe is up to sixty (60) days after a properly completed, paid, verified, and accepted order, consistent with the FTC Mail, Internet, or Telephone Order Merchandise Rule (16 C.F.R. Part 435) and Section 8.7 of the Terms of Sale. Most orders ship well sooner, but this sixty-day window is the timeframe stated for purposes of that Rule.

Cryptocurrency orders begin processing after the required on-chain confirmations are received.

2. Shipping Methods — You Choose Your Carrier

At checkout, you select the carrier and the speed for your order. We offer the following domestic options:

  • UPS — Ground (3–5 business days), 2nd Day Air, and Next Day Air
  • FedEx — Ground (3–5 business days), 2-Day, and Standard Overnight

Live rates for your address are shown at checkout. Delivery times are estimates provided by the carrier and are not guaranteed. Your carrier and speed selection is recorded on your order — choose the carrier and service that performs best for your delivery address and receiving situation.

3. Carrier Responsibility & Risk of Loss

Peptide Tech's delivery role is to professionally package your order and hand it to the carrier you selected at checkout. Per the Terms of Sale accepted and e-signed at checkout, title and risk of loss pass to you at the carrier's first acceptance scan — from that moment, transportation and delivery are handled exclusively by your chosen carrier under their own terms of service.

If a package shows a "delivered" carrier scan but you did not receive it, the carrier — not Peptide Tech — holds the delivery scan, GPS record, and proof-of-delivery photo, and pays validated delivery claims. Per Terms §8.10, a non-receipt claim requires: (1) a claim filed with the delivering carrier (claim number), (2) a police or theft report filed with your local agency (report number), and (3) a signed non-receipt declaration — submitted through our guided support flow. Packages that were never scanned in, or that stop moving in transit, qualify for a free reship through the same flow — no claim forms needed.

4. Cold-Chain Shipping

Peptech ships all lyophilized (freeze-dried) peptides at ambient temperature. Lyophilized peptides are stable for extended periods at room temperature and do not require cold-chain shipping. For reconstituted or temperature-sensitive products where cold-chain is required, we use insulated packaging with cold packs at no additional charge. Our packaging is designed to maintain appropriate temperatures for 48–72 hours during transit.

5. Free Shipping

Free Ground shipping (via your selected carrier) is automatically applied to domestic orders with a subtotal of $200 or more (after discounts, before tax). Free shipping eligibility is displayed during checkout. You may upgrade to a faster method by paying the difference.

6. International Shipping

We currently ship to select international destinations on a case-by-case basis. International shipping is available for orders over $500 and requires prior approval from our compliance team. International customers are responsible for:

  • All customs duties, import taxes, and brokerage fees
  • Ensuring compliance with the import regulations of their destination country
  • Obtaining any necessary import permits or licenses for research chemicals

Peptech is not responsible for packages seized, delayed, or returned by customs authorities. International shipping fees are non-refundable. We reserve the right to refuse international orders at our discretion. For international inquiries, reach us via the contact page.

7. Tracking Information

Once your order ships, you will receive a shipping confirmation email containing your tracking number and a link to the carrier's tracking page. Tracking information typically becomes active within 24 hours of the label being created. You can also view your order status and tracking information by logging into your account.

8. Restricted Regions

We ship across the United States. In limited cases, certain states, counties, municipalities, or international destinations may be restricted where the sale, possession, or shipment of research peptides is limited by local law — any such restriction is flagged at checkout. We also reserve the right to decline orders to APO / FPO / DPO addresses, P.O. boxes in certain jurisdictions, and freight-forwarding addresses.

9. Delivery Issues

Package never scanned in, or stopped moving in transit? Start at the contact page — it checks the live carrier record, and packages with no carrier scan for 7+ days or no movement for 7+ business days unlock a free one-click reship. No claim forms needed.

Package marked "delivered" but you did not receive it? Check with household members, neighbors, building management, or your mail room first — most "missing" deliveries surface within 24 hours. If it truly isn't there, per Terms §8.10 the claim path is:

  1. File a claim with your carrier (the carrier you selected at checkout) using your tracking number — they hold the delivery scan, GPS coordinates, and proof-of-delivery photo, and they pay validated delivery claims directly.
  2. File a police or theft report with the agency covering your delivery address (most accept online or non-emergency filings) and keep the report number.
  3. Submit both numbers — carrier claim number and police report number — through our guided support flow, along with your statement.

The one exception we resolve directly: if the carrier's proof-of-delivery photo clearly shows an address that is not yours, submit it through the same flow and we will make it right ourselves. For packages the carrier confirms as lost before any delivered scan, we reship free as described above.

10. Discreet Packaging

All shipments are sent in plain, unmarked outer packaging. The return address displays our shipping fulfillment name only (no product or brand references on the exterior). Inner packaging includes climate-controlled materials as appropriate for the products in your order.

11. Contact

For questions about shipping, delivery times, or to report a delivery issue, use our support center — order tracking, delivery reports, and reships all resolve there.

Returns & Refunds Policy

Last updated: June 9, 2026

1. All Sales Are Final

All sales are final, and we do not accept returns. This is part of the agreement accepted at checkout and is standard for laboratory research materials: once a product leaves our cold chain there is no way to verify how it was stored or handled, so returned product can never re-enter inventory. Declining returns is an integrity guarantee for every researcher who orders from us — no vial you receive has ever been in anyone else's hands.

2. What We Do Cover

No returns does not mean no recourse. The following are covered, fast, through the self-service support flow:

  • Damaged, gelled, frozen, or broken on arrival — submit a photo claim within 48 hours of delivery. Verified claims are refunded to the original payment method or replaced at no cost. Do not discard the product or packaging until the claim is decided.
  • Never delivered — the support flow checks the live carrier record. Packages with no carrier scan for 7+ days, or no movement for 7+ business days in transit, qualify for a free one-click reship. Packages the carrier marked delivered are resolved through the carrier (you selected your carrier at checkout; risk of loss passes at the carrier's first scan — see the Terms of Sale): per Terms §8.10 you must file a carrier claim and a police/theft report and submit both numbers through the support flow. The one exception we resolve directly: the carrier's delivery photo clearly shows an address that is not yours.
  • Wrong item shipped (our error) — we replace or refund at no cost, including shipping.

3. Refund Timeline

  • Review: photo claims are reviewed within 1 business day.
  • Cards (via NMI): approved refunds are pushed immediately and typically appear within 5–10 business days, depending on your card issuer.
  • Cryptocurrency: refunds go to the original wallet address, usually confirming within 1–3 business days.
  • ACH / bank transfer: refunds return to the originating account within 3–5 business days.
  • You receive an email the moment a refund is initiated.

4. Order Cancellation

You may cancel an order before it has shipped — the fastest path is the contact page or the on-site chat assistant. Once an order has shipped it cannot be canceled. Charges and authorization holds on canceled orders are released automatically; most banks clear them within 1–5 business days.

5. Chargebacks and Disputes

Please contact us before initiating a chargeback or payment dispute — the claims above resolve faster than any bank process, usually within one business day. Disputes filed without first attempting resolution are handled per Section 7 of the Terms of Sale and may result in account suspension.

6. Contact

Start any claim, reship, or refund question at the contact page — the guided flow resolves most issues on the spot and connects you with the support team when it can't.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: July 2, 2026

Peptide Tech LLC, doing business as Peptech ("Peptech," "we," "us," or "our"), is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what personal information we collect, how we use and share it, how long we keep it, and the choices available to you. By using our website, creating an account, or placing an order, you acknowledge this policy.

1. Information We Collect

We collect information you provide directly, including when you:

  • Place an order: Name, email address, billing and shipping addresses, phone number, date of birth when supplied for age verification, research-use affirmations, and related order details.
  • Create an account: Name, email address, and a password hashed through Supabase Auth. We do not store plaintext passwords.
  • Contact us: Information you include in support messages, tickets, or other correspondence.
  • Subscribe to marketing: Email address and consent preferences for promotional communications.

We also collect certain technical information automatically, such as IP address, browser type, device identifiers, referring URLs, pages viewed, and cookie identifiers. We use this data for site operation, analytics, fraud prevention, and security.

2. Payment Information

Peptech does not receive, store, or transmit full card numbers, CVV codes, or expiration dates on our servers. Card payments are tokenized and processed through NMI (Network Merchants, Inc.), a PCI DSS Level 1 compliant payment gateway. We may receive a payment token and the last four digits of your card for reference.

Bitcoin payments are processed self-custodially. We generate a unique Bitcoin address for your order and verify payment on the public blockchain through block-explorer APIs. ACH and eDebit payments are processed through Mercury; we receive payment status but do not access your full bank credentials.

3. How We Use Your Information

  • Processing, fulfilling, and supporting orders
  • Maintaining accounts and order history
  • Sending transactional emails such as confirmations and shipping updates
  • Sending marketing communications only where you have opted in
  • Improving our website, products, and customer experience
  • Detecting fraud, abuse, and unauthorized activity
  • Complying with law, regulation, and valid legal process

4. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

We use cookies and similar technologies for:

  • Essential operation: Cart, authentication, security, and compliance features required for the site to function.
  • Preferences: Remembering settings such as age-gate status.
  • Analytics: Understanding site usage through services such as PostHog and Vercel Analytics.
  • Marketing measurement: Where permitted, measuring campaign and abandonment flows through providers such as Omnisend and advertising partners.

You may decline non-essential cookies through our consent controls where available. Browser settings may also limit cookies, though some site features may not work correctly if essential cookies are disabled.

5. How We Share Information

We do not sell or rent your personal information. We share information only with service providers that help us operate the business, such as payment processors, shipping carriers, email providers, analytics vendors, and hosting infrastructure. These providers may use the information only to perform services for us and subject to contractual confidentiality and security obligations. We may also disclose information when required by law or to protect rights, safety, and security.

6. Data Retention

  • Order and tax records: Retained as required for accounting, tax, fraud prevention, and legal compliance, typically for at least seven years.
  • Account information: Retained while your account remains active and as needed thereafter for legal, security, and operational purposes.
  • Marketing records: Retained until you withdraw consent or unsubscribe.
  • Analytics: May be retained in aggregated or de-identified form.

Even after a valid deletion request, we may retain certain information where retention is required or permitted by law, including completed order records, payment dispute evidence, fraud-prevention logs, and anonymized statistical data.

7. Your Privacy Rights and How to Exercise Them

Depending on where you live, you may have rights to know what personal information we maintain, to request access or correction, to request deletion, to opt out of certain processing, or to receive information in a portable format. Peptech does not sell personal information for monetary consideration.

Privacy rights requests — including requests to delete personal data — are not processed online or by email. To submit a verifiable request, you must send a written letter by U.S. Mail to the address below. We do not accept deletion requests by email, web form, phone, fax, or social media.

Peptide Tech LLC
Attn: Privacy Officer
1309 Coffeen Ave STE 14346
Sheridan, WY 82801

Your letter must include, at minimum:

  • Your full legal name
  • The email address associated with your Peptech account or orders
  • A clear statement of the request (for example, deletion of personal data, access to personal data, or correction of inaccurate information)
  • Enough information for us to verify your identity and match the request to the correct customer record
  • A current mailing address where we may send our written response
  • Your signature and the date

If you are an authorized agent acting on behalf of a consumer, your letter must also include proof of authorization acceptable under applicable law. We may request additional verification before fulfilling a request.

We will respond to verifiable written requests within the time required by applicable law, typically within 45 days. We may extend that period where permitted by law after notifying you in writing. We do not discriminate against consumers who exercise privacy rights.

For browser-based opt-out of certain analytics and marketing cookies, see our Do Not Sell or Share page. That opt-out does not delete account or order records and is not a substitute for a written deletion request.

8. Children's Privacy

Our services are intended only for individuals 21 years of age or older. We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 21. If we learn that we have collected such information, we will delete it as required by law.

9. Security

We use administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards designed to protect personal information, including encryption in transit and access controls. No internet transmission or storage system is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

10. International Users

Our services are operated in the United States. If you access the site from outside the U.S., your information may be transferred to and processed in the United States, where privacy laws may differ from those in your jurisdiction.

11. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Last updated" date. Your continued use of the site after changes become effective constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.

12. Contact for Privacy Requests

All privacy-rights requests, including requests to delete personal data, must be submitted by written letter to:

Peptide Tech LLC
Attn: Privacy Officer
1309 Coffeen Ave STE 14346
Sheridan, WY 82801

3.1 As-shipped only.

The guarantee covers the analytical condition of the Product as shipped — sealed, unopened, and in its original lyophilized (dry) state — at the time of shipment. It does not guarantee the condition of the Product after delivery.

3.2 Definition of purity.

"Purity" means chromatographic purity expressed as area-percent determined by reverse-phase HPLC using the method, column, gradient, mobile phase, and detection parameters stated on or referenced by the applicable COA (or, where none is stated, our then-current validated release method for that Product). All testing for any claim must use that method. Results from a materially different method, or that do not report area-% purity, are not probative of a breach.

Verified Peptides

"Verified" should mean something specific: that a research peptide's identity and purity have been independently confirmed and documented — not just claimed. Here is what real verification looks like, how to check any supplier, and how Peptide Technologies documents every batch.

How to verify any research peptide supplier

Whether you buy from us or anyone else, use this checklist. It separates documented research suppliers from marketing.

A public Certificate of Analysis on every batch

A verified supplier publishes a batch-specific COA — not a generic sample. Look for the actual lot number, HPLC purity, identity confirmation, and the name of an accredited, independent laboratory. If the certificate isn't lot-specific or isn't public, it isn't verification.

HPLC purity confirmed by an independent lab

Purity should be measured by reversed-phase HPLC and identity confirmed by mass spectrometry, at a third-party lab rather than in-house. A real figure for the exact lot you receive beats a blanket "99% pure" marketing claim every time.

Lot traceability you can audit

You should be able to trace the vial in your hand back to its certificate — ideally by scanning a QR code on the label that links to the published COA. Traceability is what lets you verify before and after purchase.

A transparent, US-based operation

Check where the material is filled, finished, and tested, and whether the company is reachable. A verified supplier is transparent about being US-based, ships domestically with appropriate handling, and answers questions.

Clear research-use-only terms

Legitimate research suppliers label products for laboratory research use only, require you to affirm research use at checkout, and never make health, medical, or personal-use claims. Clear compliance is a signal of a serious operation.

Independent reputation signals

Cross-check reviews on independent platforms, look for consistent lot documentation over time, and confirm the certificates trace to a real accredited lab. Reputation should be verifiable, not just asserted.

How Peptide Technologies verifies every batch

We built the company on one rule: no claim without a receipt. No batch is listed until it clears a full analytical panel — identity, purity, net content, and conformity — at an accredited US laboratory. What are verified peptides?

How do I verify a research peptide is what it claims to be?
Check the batch-specific Certificate of Analysis for the exact lot you received: it should show HPLC purity, an identity confirmation (mass spectrometry), the lot number, and the name of an accredited independent lab. Being able to scan a QR code on the vial that links to the published certificate is the strongest form of verification.
What should I look for in the best research peptide companies?
The checklist that matters: a public, batch-specific COA from an accredited third-party lab; HPLC purity plus mass-spec identity; lot traceability (ideally QR-linked); a transparent US-based operation; clear research-use-only terms; and verifiable independent reputation signals. Marketing claims without documentation don't count.
